regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrowing: only 5 of 17 themes are eligible (frac 0.29, view 'narrowing'), with Banks (H + HK) leading Energy (H-shares) by a thin margin (0.184) and no single dominant narrative (one_narrative false). Momentum rank-IC is weak/insignificant on this universe and the absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge (gate_helps true), so this is a staying-power/discipline read, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) breadth holds above 0.8 as its durability_bar stays >0.6 — that sustained cohesion alongside a widening margin over Banks would mark a confirmed handoff into Energy leadership, while a durability_bar drop below 0.6 retires the watch.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy (H-shares) is the only theme combining the validated trend gate (eligible true) with a clean trend state: durability_bar 0.8 (highest in the book), hurst_tag 'trend', and breadth 0.9 — the coARSest, most cohesive eligible leadership. Rank 2 and a tight margin to Banks (0.184) put it in confirmed challenger position, not a crowded extension (crowding_z 0.24). The lean is supported by the trend-gate + durability + breadth legs, not the rank itself.
evidence: breadth: 0.90 (best theme-level breadth in the book)
theses.dissent: The headline leader is Banks (rank 1, score 1.337 vs Energy 1.153) and rotation.margin is only 0.184 with absorption 0.47 — leadership is contested, not confirmed; Energy's breadth could collapse quickly if commodities reverse and the rank-IC is ~0 so the momentum edge is illusory.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) durability_bar drops below 0.60 or breadth falls under 0.5 before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the third eligible theme with a genuine trend profile: durability_bar 0.65, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.75. It sits mid-rank (4) and non-crowded (crowding_z 0.05), offering a defensive/income tilt within the eligible set that also passes the trend gate. Supported by trend-gate + durability + breadth legs; the rank itself carries no forward edge.
theses.dissent: It is only rank 4 and lagging two stronger eligible themes; high-dividend in HK is closely tied to rate and property sensitivity, and if the narrowing continues the ineligible tail could drag the broader Hang Seng without this theme providing alpha.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips breadth falls below 0.5 or hurst_tag flips to mean-revert before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is eligible (rank 11, score -0.38) but shows a broken trend structure for a top-down lean: breadth only 0.167 and hurst_tag 'trend' combined with a deeply negative score. Passing the gate while losing momentum and low breadth makes it a non-theme for this desk — a conditional avoid rather than a short. Supported by trend-gate (passed but weak) + breadth degradation.
evidence: eligible: true but score -0.38 (only eligible theme with negative score)
theses.dissent: A marginal eligible theme with a 'trend' hurst tag could still outperform if semis reverse on an AI narrative; avoiding it forfeits upside in a mean-reverting sector.

falsifier.text: Tech Hardware & Semis breadth recovers above 0.5 while score turns positive before the check-by date
